'''Drilling droids''' were used for [[Ore/Legends|ore]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Averill]]. The [[Jarrad mine-clan]]'s lack of funds to purchase drilling droids led to the crippling of [[Selby Jarrad]]'s father in a mining accident.<ref name="COI">{{JournalCite|13|Conflict of Interest}}</ref>
